head: codex/5912-runtime-birth-witness
title: [v0.92][runtime][birth-witness] Add production policy and receipt boundary
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5912

## Summary
- add a Runtime-owned service that provisions the opaque four-role birth-witness policy from trusted configuration
- add one production path that builds, validates, canonically serializes, prepares, and commits a caveated receipt
- use a two-phase sink contract so preparation failures cannot commit receipt side effects
- add external integration proof for successful canonical emission, invalid-witness pre-sink rejection, and sink-preparation failure

## Validation
- focused production-path validator: 1 passed
- external birth_witness integration target: 2 passed
- retained birth-witness authority suite: 13 passed
- strict all-target Clippy and diff hygiene: passed
- independent exact-head review: PASS; one P2 fixed and no actionable findings remain

## Non-claims
This PR does not alter the witness algorithm or receipt schema and does not claim birth, citizenship, governance, legal, or launch authority.
